title: thelypteris angustibasis
intro: Thelypteris angustibasis, commonly known as the narrow-leaved maiden fern or  Angustifolia fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris angustibasis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris angustibasis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
